method.method_draft: Read the image as the equation skeleton 6 □ 9 □ 12 □ 15 □ 18 □ 21 = 45. From the text, use that four boxes must be plus signs and exactly one box must be a minus sign. First pretend all five gaps are '+': the left side would be 6+9+12+15+18+21=81. Changing the sign before one number from '+' to '−' lowers the total by twice that number. Since the desired total is 45, the needed decrease is 81−45=36, so the number after the minus must be 36/2=18. Therefore the minus goes in the gap immediately before 18, between 15 and 18.
